description:
Repent Sackcloth Apparel is a faith-based clothing brand designed to inspire boldness in believers through high-quality, custom-designed apparel. Our mission is to empower Christians to live unapologetically and proudly in their faith, wearing messages that reflect strength, hope, and dedication to God’s word. Each piece of clothing is designed with purpose, crafted from durable materials, and adorned with faith-filled designs to spark conversation and encourage others to stand firm in their beliefs.

Product Description:

Repent Sackcloth Apparel offers a range of premium-quality apparel, including t-shirts, hoodies, sweatshirts, and hats, all designed to inspire and encourage believers in their walk of faith. Our clothing features unique designs, scriptures, and inspiring messages that promote living boldly and unapologetically in Christ. We use high-quality fabrics that are comfortable and long-lasting, ensuring that our customers are not only expressing their faith but doing so in style and comfort.

Unique Selling Point:

At Repent Sackcloth Apparel, we provide more than just clothing – we offer a way for believers to wear their faith proudly. Our custom designs are inspired by scripture, boldness, and purpose, allowing wearers to be a walking testimony of their beliefs. What sets us apart is our unwavering commitment to quality, authenticity, and purpose-driven design. Our apparel empowers individuals to boldly declare their faith while supporting a brand that aligns with their values and vision for a faith-filled lifestyle.

Payment Terms:

  • Commission Structure: Affiliates will earn 10% of the total sale price for each successful purchase made through their referral link.
  • Payment Frequency: Affiliates will receive payouts on a monthly basis, or once a minimum threshold of $100 is reached.
  • Payment Methods: Payments will be processed via PayPal, Bank Transfer, or any other payment method available on the affiliate platform.
  • Cookie Duration: The affiliate’s referral link will remain active for 30 days after the first click, ensuring that affiliates receive credit for any purchases made during that time frame.

Other Information:

  • Sign-up Process: Affiliates can sign up directly on our website via the affiliate program sign-up page. After approval, they will receive a unique affiliate link and access to their dashboard where they can track their earnings.
  • Promotional Materials: Affiliates will have access to a variety of banners, logos, and custom coupon codes for promoting Repent Sackcloth Apparel across their websites, blogs, and social media platforms.
  • Customer Support: Affiliates will receive ongoing support from our team. We are committed to helping our affiliates succeed and will provide resources and advice to help them effectively promote our brand.
  • Restrictions: Affiliates are not allowed to engage in unethical marketing tactics such as spamming, bidding on our brand name in paid advertising, or misleading potential customers.
  • Exclusive Offers for Affiliates: We occasionally provide special discounts, bonuses, and incentives for top-performing affiliates.
